title: Raise member free minutes to 45 for the spring promotion
author: kasia.brandt
body:
## Change

During the spring promotion, members get 45 minutes of free riding at the top of every trip instead of the usual free window.

## Testing

Updated the pricing e2e suite for the new free-minutes case and reran it locally; green.

comments.author: mara.voss
comments.body: Looks good. Can you link the promotion copy so support has the same numbers we're shipping?
